system.description:
This skill allows the character to construct small watercraft, including canoes, dugouts, barges and planked and tarred longboats.

Obstacles: Repair or retarring, Ob 1. Dugout, skiff or raft, Ob 2. Rowboat or small barge, Ob 3. Large barge or longboat, Ob 4. Small sailing vessel, Ob 5.

FoRKs: Carpenter

Skill Type: Craftsman. Tools: Workshop.

Root: Per/Agi

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 260
